quotes.author: Jim Russo
quotes.text: We have rented several times from 3 2 1 every single time. The experience has been amazing. We rented this past Sunday and due to some inclement unforeseen weather we had to cut our day short, which we understand you can't control the weather 321 was nice enough Steve and James particularly to give us a gift card for future use since our trip was cut short. I would definitely recommend using 321.

+2We had such a wonderful day on the water thanks to 321 boat club. From when we arrived there was someone there with a cart to take our stuff to the boat. We were explained everything about our boat and what to do in a problem. We had a beautiful day and when we returned they were there waiting for us. So glad we did this and you will not be disappointed.

quotes.author: Steven Bollon
quotes.text: Had a great outing at 321 Boat rental. James facilitated a boating basics course with us and showed us all the necessities including navigation, speed, plaining, trim, turns, emergency man-overboard procedures, and most importantly docking. He was fantastic. This was a great experience that we will be doing again.

quotes.author: ashlynn weston
quotes.text: I had such a fun day out on the water with Capt James! It was so gorgeous out and he did such a great job showing us some cool spots and helping make sure we were all (including our boxer) taken care of!
+2Thank you for such a fun experience with our family! We will definitely be back!!

quotes.author: Tim Wilson
quotes.text: We had a Great experience. Very friendly and helpful staff.
